title: HermesProfile record
description: The per-agent instance record (profile.yaml) pushed to the GitOps repo. v1alpha2 removes four fields no consumer read: spec.targetCluster, spec.reach (whose only key was regions), and spec.deployment.{machineType,region,diskType} - leftovers from the deleted VM compute path. See plugin/schemas/README.md for the migration note. Fully-resolved instance record for a single installed Hermes agent — PLAIN HELM VALUES for the hermes-profile chart, not a Kubernetes custom resource (there is no HermesProfile CRD). The record's identity is its directory name (profiles/<name>/profile.yaml, read by the ApplicationSet as {{.path.basename}}); the emitter enforces the name rules (DNS-1123 label, max 40 chars). Desired-state only; no status block.

spec.description: The record's single top-level block. Every field under it doubles as a Helm value for the hermes-profile chart - there is no translation step.

persona.description: The installed instance name - identical to the record's directory name under profiles/. The chart stamps it on every rendered resource as the persona label.

source.description: Git URL or path, e.g. github.com/factorylevel/support-agent

gitAuthSecretRef.description: Name of a Kubernetes Secret in the instance's own namespace holding the credential to clone a PRIVATE spec.source: keys username+password (HTTPS PAT) or ssh-privatekey (SSH deploy key). Omit for public sources.

ref.description: Git ref the install resolved spec.sha from, recorded for provenance - the pod boots from spec.sha, not from this ref. Omitted when the install named none.

sourceSubdir.description: Subdirectory of spec.source containing the distribution (the Hermes fork's --subdir / #subdirectory= install form). The pod boot path installs /tmp/dist/<sourceSubdir> from its clone. Omit for root-layout sources.

sha.description: Full commit SHA (40 lowercase hex chars).

distributionVersion.description: The version the distribution declared at install time, recorded for provenance.

baseImageTag.description: Tag of the Hermes agent container image this instance runs; overrides the platform's image tag for both the bootstrap initContainer and the main container.

diskSizeGb.description: Size in GiB of the instance's data volume claim. Default when absent: 10.

apps.description: The RESOLVED helm apps this instance launches, in author order - the emitter has already deep-merged author values + fleet defaults + per-instance appValues overrides into `values`, and every `valuesRequired` dot-path was satisfied pre-render (so that field is dropped from the record). The chart renders one Argo CD Application per entry (app-of-apps).

name.description: DNS-label app name, unique within the record.

chart.description: Chart name in the remote helm repo, or (for `repo: local`) the chart's path inside the platform/GitOps chart tree.

repo.description: Helm repo URL (https:// or oci://), or the reserved word `local` (chart ships with the platform/GitOps repo).

version.description: Chart version - present for remote repos (the Application's targetRevision), absent for `repo: local`.

values.description: The fully-merged chart values (author values + fleet defaults + per-instance overrides), inlined.

envRequires.description: Every environment variable this profile needs, WITH the metadata the declaration carried. v1alpha2 and earlier stored a flat array of names, discarding the description, the required flag and the secret-versus-config distinction - the three facts the capability model and the secret lifecycle need (#141, #171, #149). Both shapes are accepted: a bare string is an entry with name only, and means `required: true, secret: true` by the same conservative default the resolver applies.

required.description: Absent means REQUIRED - the same default the distribution manifest applies, so an entry that says nothing is treated as mandatory rather than optional.

secret.description: A credential rather than configuration. Absent means TRUE: treating an unclassified value as a secret costs an ExternalSecret; treating a secret as config puts it in a rendered manifest.

expose.description: HTTP services on the agent pod to route ingress to, plus the access policy the tunnel ingress applies.

services.description: The exposed services. Each becomes a named port on the instance's Service and a routing rule on the configured ingress provider.

name.description: DNS-label service name; becomes the port's name on the instance's Kubernetes Service.

port.description: TCP port on the agent pod this service targets.

path.description: HTTP path prefix routed to this service. Default when absent: /.

access.description: Access control for the exposed services under the Cloudflare tunnel ingress.

policy.description: Who may reach the exposed services: service-token = named machine clients, idp = people via the identity provider, mixed = both. Default when absent: service-token.

backup.description: Backup intent - schedule and retention only; the destination is a platform concern (providers.backup in cluster-values).

schedule.description: Cron expression for the CronJob that archives the instance's data volume.

retention.description: How many of the newest archives are kept; older ones are pruned. Default when absent: 7.
